stories.title: Police appeal for help finding missing 60-year-old woman from Pentre Halkyn
stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for help to find a 60-year-old woman who has been missing from the Pentre Halkyn area since this morning. stories.title: Rhun ap Iorwerth has named his first Cabinet as First Minister of Wales
stories.summary: Rhun ap Iorwerth has named his first Cabinet as First Minister of Wales, with a Plaid Cymru-led minority government taking office in Cardiff. stories.title: Four M53 bridges to be replaced in £50m three-year works package
stories.summary: Drivers using the M53 between Chester and Wirral face three years of disruption from Monday, as National Highways begins a £50m programme of bridge replacements, resurfacing and drainage works. stories.title: Castle Green returns with revised 276-home plan for Ewloe site after refusal
stories.summary: Castle Green Homes has lodged a fresh planning application for the construction of 276 homes at a site in Ewloe.
